1.54.m: Brahmā said: / These wonderful, divine boons have been granted by me to you, my dear child. / Therefore, you shall attain all these desires; there is no doubt.

1.54.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamuktvā sa bhagavāñjagāmā''kāśameva hi ..
vairājaṃ devasadanaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam .. 16 ..
1.54.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवाञ्जगामा'ऽकाशमेव हि ॥
वैराजं देवसदनं महर्षिगणसेवितम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.54.m: Śaṅkara said: / Having spoken thus, the Lord went directly to the sky, / to the Vairāja abode of the gods, frequented by the multitudes of great sages.

1.54.s:
tato devāśca nāgāśca gandharvā munayastathā ..
varapradānaṃ śrutvaiva pitāmahamupasthitāḥ .. .. 17 ..
1.54.d:
ततो देवाश्च नागाश्च गन्धर्वा मुनयस्तथा ॥
वरप्रदानं श्रुत्वैव पितामहमुपस्थिताः ॥ ॥ 17 ॥
1.54.m: Then the gods, Nāgas, Gandharvas, and sages, / hearing of the granting of the boon, approached the Grandfather.

1.54.s:
devā ūcuḥ ..
vareṇā'nena bhagavānvadhiṣyati sa no'suraḥ ..
tannaḥ prasīda bhagavanvadho'pyasya vicintyatām .. 18 ..
1.54.d:
देवा ऊचुः ॥
वरेणाऽनेन भगवान्वधिष्यति स नोऽसुरः ॥
तन्नः प्रसीद भगवन्वधोऽप्यस्य विचिन्त्यताम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.54.m: The gods said: / By this boon, O Lord, that Asura will slay us. / Therefore, be gracious to us, O Lord, and let his destruction be devised!

1.54.s:
bhagavānsarvabhūtānāṃ svayambhūrādikṛtprabhuḥ ..
sraṣṭā ca havyakavyānāṃ cā'vyaktaḥ prakṛtirdhruvaḥ .. 19 ..
1.54.d:
भगवान्सर्वभूतानां स्वयम्भूरादिकृत्प्रभुः ॥
स्रष्टा च हव्यकव्यानां चाऽव्यक्तः प्रकृतिर्ध्रुवः ॥ 19 ॥
1.54.m: You are the Lord of all beings, the self-existent, the primeval creator, the master, / the maker of oblations to gods and ancestors, the unmanifest, primal matter, eternal.

1.54.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
sarvalokahitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ ..
provāca varado vākyaṃ sarvāndevagaṇāṃstataḥ .. 1.54.20 ..
1.54.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
सर्वलोकहितं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा देवः प्रजापतिः ॥
प्रोवाच वरदो वाक्यं सर्वान्देवगणांस्ततः ॥ 1.54.20 ॥
1.54.m: Śaṅkara said: / Having heard the speech that aimed at the welfare of all worlds, the divine Prajāpati, / the grantor of boons, then spoke words to all the hosts of gods:

1.54.s:
brahmovāca ..
avaśyaṃ tridaśāstena prāptavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ..
tatastasya vadhaṃ viṣṇustapaso'nte kariṣyati .. 21 ..
1.54.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
अवश्यं त्रिदशास्तेन प्राप्तव्यं तपसः फलम् ॥
ततस्तस्य वधं विष्णुस्तपसोऽन्ते करिष्यति ॥ 21 ॥
1.54.m: Brahmā said: / Inevitably, O thirty [gods], the fruit of his penance must be attained by him. / Thereafter, at the end of his penance, Viṣṇu will carry out his death.

1.54.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evaṃ śrutvā surāḥ sarve vākyaṃ paṅkajajanmanaḥ ..
svāni sthānāni divyāni jagmuste vai mudānvitāḥ .. 22 ..
1.54.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
एवं श्रुत्वा सुराः सर्वे वाक्यं पङ्कजजन्मनः ॥
स्वानि स्थानानि दिव्यानि जग्मुस्ते वै मुदान्विताः ॥ 22 ॥
1.54.m: Śaṅkara said: / Having thus heard the words of the lotus-born [Brahmā], all the gods, / filled with joy, went to their own divine realms.

1.54.s:
laghumātre vare tasminsarvāḥ so'bādhata prajāḥ ..
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo varadānena darpitaḥ .. 23 ..
1.54.d:
लघुमात्रे वरे तस्मिन्सर्वाः सोऽबाधत प्रजाः ॥
हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो वरदानेन दर्पितः ॥ 23 ॥
1.54.m: With merely that slight boon, he oppressed all the creatures; / the Daitya Hiraṇyakaśipu was proud because of the granting of the boon.

1.54.s:
āśrameṣu mahātmāno munīndrānsaṃśitavratān ..
satyadharmaratāndāntāndurādharṣobhavaṃstu saḥ..24..
1.54.d:
आश्रमेषु महात्मानो मुनीन्द्रान्संशितव्रतान् ॥
सत्यधर्मरतान्दान्तान्दुराधर्षोभवंस्तु सः॥24॥
1.54.m: In the hermitages, he became irresistible to the high-souled lords of munis, / who were resolute in their vows, devoted to truth and dharma, and self-restrained.

1.54.s:
devāstribhuvasthāṃśca parājitya mahāsuraḥ.. .
trailokyaṃ vaśamānīya svarge vasati dānavaḥ .. 25 ..
1.54.d:
देवास्त्रिभुवस्थांश्च पराजित्य महासुरः॥ ।
त्रैलोक्यं वशमानीय स्वर्गे वसति दानवः ॥ 25 ॥
1.54.m: Having conquered the gods dwelling in the three worlds, / and bringing the three worlds under his sway, the great Asura, the Dānava, dwelt in heaven.

1.54.s:
yadā varamadonmatto hyāvāsaṃ kṛtavān divi ..
yājñiyānkṛtavāndaityānayājñeyāśca devatā .. 26 ..
1.54.d:
यदा वरमदोन्मत्तो ह्यावासं कृतवान् दिवि ॥
याज्ञियान्कृतवान्दैत्यानयाज्ञेयाश्च देवता ॥ 26 ॥
1.54.m: When, intoxicated with pride over the boon, he made his dwelling in heaven, / he made the Daityas eligible to receive sacrifices and made the deities ineligible for sacrifices.

1.54.s:
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevāstathā'śvinau ..
bhṛgavo'ṅgirasaḥ sādhyā marutaśca savāsavāḥ .. 27 ..
1.54.d:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा विश्वेदेवास्तथाऽश्विनौ ॥
भृगवोऽङ्गिरसः साध्या मरुतश्च सवासवाः ॥ 27 ॥
1.54.m: The Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, Viśvedevas, as well as the two Aśvins, / the Bhṛgus, Aṅgirases, Sādhyas, and the Maruts along with Indra,

1.54.s:
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇumupatasthurmahābalam ..
devaṃ brahmamayaṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmabhūtaṃ sanātanam .. 28 ..
1.54.d:
शरण्यं शरणं विष्णुमुपतस्थुर्महाबलम् ॥
देवं ब्रह्ममयं विष्णुं ब्रह्मभूतं सनातनम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.54.m: approached Viṣṇu of great power, worthy of refuge, as their refuge— / the god Viṣṇu, who is composed of Brahman, who has become Brahman, the eternal one,

1.54.s:
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasya prabhuṃ lokaparāyaṇam ..
nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃ devāḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ..29..
1.54.d:
भूतभव्यभविष्यस्य प्रभुं लोकपरायणम् ॥
नारायणं विभुं देवाः शरण्यं शरणं गताः ॥29॥
1.54.m: the Lord of the past, present, and future, the ultimate refuge of the world. / The gods went for refuge to the all-pervading Nārāyaṇa, the protector.

1.54.s:
devā ūcuḥ..
trāyasva no'dya deveśa hiraṇyakaśiporvadhāt ..
tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo devo brahmādīnāṃ surottama .. 1.54.30 ..
1.54.d:
देवा ऊचुः॥
त्रायस्व नोऽद्य देवेश हिरण्यकशिपोर्वधात् ॥
त्वं हि नः परमो देवो ब्रह्मादीनां सुरोत्तम ॥ 1.54.30 ॥
1.54.m: The gods said: / Protect us today, O Lord of gods, from slaughter by Hiraṇyakaśipu! / For you are our supreme god, the foremost of gods, above Brahmā and the rest,

1.54.s:
protphullāmalapatrākṣa śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkara ..
kṣayāya ditivaṃśasya śaraṇaṃ tvaṃ bhavasva naḥ .. 31 ..
1.54.d:
प्रोत्फुल्लामलपत्राक्ष शत्रुपक्षक्षयंकर ॥
क्षयाय दितिवंशस्य शरणं त्वं भवस्व नः ॥ 31 ॥
1.54.m: O lotus-eyed one, O destroyer of the enemies' party! / For the destruction of Diti's lineage, become our refuge!

1.54.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
bhayaṃ tyajadhvamamarā abhayaṃ vo dadāmyaham ..
tathaiva tridivaṃ devāḥ pratipadyata mā ciram .. 32 ..
1.54.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥
भयं त्यजध्वममरा अभयं वो ददाम्यहम् ॥
तथैव त्रिदिवं देवाः प्रतिपद्यत मा चिरम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.54.m: The holy Lord said: / Cast off fear, O immortals! I grant you freedom from fear. / In that very way, O gods, regain the third heaven without delay!

1.54.s:
eṣo'muṃ sabalaṃ daityaṃ varadānena darpitam..
avadhyamamareṃdrāṇāṃ dānavendraṃ nihanmyaham .. 33 ..
1.54.d:
एषोऽमुं सबलं दैत्यं वरदानेन दर्पितम्॥
अवध्यममरेंद्राणां दानवेन्द्रं निहन्म्यहम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.54.m: I shall slay that Daitya along with his army, who is arrogant from the granting of the boon, / that lord of Dānavas who cannot be slain by the lords of the immortals.

1.54.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamuktvā sa bhagavānvisṛjya tridiveśvarān ..
nārasiṃhaṃ vapuścakra sahasrāṃśusamaprabham .. 34 ..
1.54.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्विसृज्य त्रिदिवेश्वरान् ॥
नारसिंहं वपुश्चक्र सहस्रांशुसमप्रभम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.54.m: Śaṅkara said: / Having spoken thus and dismissed the lords of the third heaven, the Lord / assumed the form of Narasiṃha, radiant as a thousand suns,

1.54.s:
prāṃśuṃ kanakaśailābhaṃ jvālāpuñjavibhūṣitam ..
daityasainyamahāmbhodhi vaḍavānalavarcasam .. 35 ..
1.54.d:
प्रांशुं कनकशैलाभं ज्वालापुञ्जविभूषितम् ॥
दैत्यसैन्यमहाम्भोधि वडवानलवर्चसम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.54.m: tall, resembling a mountain of gold, adorned with a mass of flames, / possessing the brilliance of the submarine fire against the great ocean of the Daitya army,

1.54.s:
sandhyānuraktameghābhaṃ nīlavāsasamacyutam ..
devadāruvanacchannaṃ yathā meruṃ mahāgirim .. 36 ..
1.54.d:
सन्ध्यानुरक्तमेघाभं नीलवाससमच्युतम् ॥
देवदारुवनच्छन्नं यथा मेरुं महागिरिम् ॥ 36 ॥
1.54.m: resembling a cloud reddened by twilight, clad in blue garments, the imperishable one, / like Mount Meru, the great mountain, covered by a forest of deodars,

1.54.s:
saṃpūrṇavaktradaśanaiḥ śaśāṅkaśakalopamaiḥ ..
pūrṇaṃ muktāphalaiḥ śubhraiḥ samudramiva kāñcanam .. 37 ..
1.54.d:
संपूर्णवक्त्रदशनैः शशाङ्कशकलोपमैः ॥
पूर्णं मुक्ताफलैः शुभ्रैः समुद्रमिव काञ्चनम् ॥ 37 ॥
1.54.m: filled with teeth in his mouth resembling pieces of the moon, / like a golden ocean filled with white pearls,

1.54.s:
nakhairvidrumasaṃkāśairvirājitakaradvayam ..
daityanāthakṣayakaraiḥ krodhasyaiva yathāṅkuraiḥ .. 38 ..
1.54.d:
नखैर्विद्रुमसंकाशैर्विराजितकरद्वयम् ॥
दैत्यनाथक्षयकरैः क्रोधस्यैव यथाङ्कुरैः ॥ 38 ॥
1.54.m: with his two hands adorned with claws resembling coral, / which brought destruction to the lord of the Daityas, like sprouts of wrath itself,

1.54.s:
saṭābhāraṃ sakuṭilaṃ vahnijvālāgrapiṃgalam ..
dhārayanbhāti sarvātmā dāvānalamivācalaḥ .. 39 ..
1.54.d:
सटाभारं सकुटिलं वह्निज्वालाग्रपिंगलम् ॥
धारयन्भाति सर्वात्मा दावानलमिवाचलः ॥ 39 ॥
1.54.m: bearing a mass of curved manes, reddish-brown like the tips of blazing fires, / the Self of all shone like a mountain [wrapped in] a forest fire.

1.54.s:
dṛśyādṛśyamukhe tasya jihvābhyuditacañcalā ..
pralayāntāmbudasyeva cañcalā tu taḍillatā .. 1.54.40 ..
1.54.d:
दृश्यादृश्यमुखे तस्य जिह्वाभ्युदितचञ्चला ॥
प्रलयान्ताम्बुदस्येव चञ्चला तु तडिल्लता ॥ 1.54.40 ॥
1.54.m: In his barely visible mouth, his restless tongue emerged, / fluttering like a flash of lightning from a cloud at the dissolution of the world.

1.54.s:
āvarttibhirlomaghanairvyāptaṃ vigrahamūrjitam ..
mahākaṭitaṭaskandhamalātapratimekṣaṇam .. 41 ..
1.54.d:
आवर्त्तिभिर्लोमघनैर्व्याप्तं विग्रहमूर्जितम् ॥
महाकटितटस्कन्धमलातप्रतिमेक्षणम् ॥ 41 ॥
1.54.m: His mighty body was covered with whirlpools of dense hair, / with broad hips and shoulders, and eyes resembling burning coals.

1.54.s:
kalpāntameghanirghoṣajvālāniḥśvāsamārutam ..
durnirīkṣyaṃ durādharṣaṃ vajramadhyavibhīṣaṇam .. 42 ..
1.54.d:
कल्पान्तमेघनिर्घोषज्वालानिःश्वासमारुतम् ॥
दुर्निरीक्ष्यं दुराधर्षं वज्रमध्यविभीषणम् ॥ 42 ॥
1.54.m: His breath was a wind of fire sounding like the clouds at the end of the aeon, / hard to look at, unassailable, terrifying as the middle of a thunderbolt.

1.54.s:
kṛtvā mūrtiṃ nṛsiṃhasya dānaveṃdrasabhāṃ yayau ..
tāmbabhañja tu vegena daityānāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ.. 43 ..
1.54.d:
कृत्वा मूर्तिं नृसिंहस्य दानवेंद्रसभां ययौ ॥
ताम्बभञ्ज तु वेगेन दैत्यानां भयवर्धनः॥ 43 ॥
1.54.m: Having assumed the form of Nṛsiṃha, he went to the assembly of the lord of the Dānavas; / and with fury he shattered it, increasing the terror of the Daityas.

1.54.s:
bhajyamānāṃ sabhāṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛsiṃhena mahātmanā ..
hiraṇyakaśipū rājā dānavānsamacodayat .. 44 ..
1.54.d:
भज्यमानां सभां दृष्ट्वा नृसिंहेन महात्मना ॥
हिरण्यकशिपू राजा दानवान्समचोदयत् ॥ 44 ॥
1.54.m: Seeing the assembly being smashed by the great-souled Nṛsiṃha, / King Hiraṇyakaśipu commanded the Dānavas:

1.54.s:
sattvajātamidaṃ ghoraṃ cāpūrvaṃ punarāgatam ..
ghātayadhvaṃ durādharṣaṃ yena me nāśitā sabhā ..45..
1.54.d:
सत्त्वजातमिदं घोरं चापूर्वं पुनरागतम् ॥
घातयध्वं दुराधर्षं येन मे नाशिता सभा ॥45॥
1.54.m: This terrifying, unprecedented creature has come again! / Kill this unassailable being by whom my assembly hall has been destroyed!

1.54.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daityāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ..
āyudhairvividhairjaghnurdevadevaṃ janārdanam .. 46 ..
1.54.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दैत्याः शतसहस्रशः ॥
आयुधैर्विविधैर्जघ्नुर्देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ॥ 46 ॥
1.54.m: Hearing those words of his, the Daityas in their hundreds and thousands / struck Janārdana, the god of gods, with various weapons.

1.54.s:
nānāyudhasahasrāṇi tasya gātreṣu bhārgava ..
viśīrṇānyeva dṛśyante mṛlloṣṭānīva parvate .. 47 ..
1.54.d:
नानायुधसहस्राणि तस्य गात्रेषु भार्गव ॥
विशीर्णान्येव दृश्यन्ते मृल्लोष्टानीव पर्वते ॥ 47 ॥
1.54.m: O descendant of Bhṛgu, the thousands of various weapons upon his limbs / were seen to shatter like clods of earth upon a mountain.

1.54.s:
daityāyudhānāṃ vaiphalyaṃ kṛtvā hatvā ca dānavān ..
karapādaprahāraiśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 48 ..
1.54.d:
दैत्यायुधानां वैफल्यं कृत्वा हत्वा च दानवान् ॥
करपादप्रहारैश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥ 48 ॥
1.54.m: Rendering the weapons of the Daityas futile and striking down the Dānavas / in their hundreds and thousands with blows of his hands and feet,

1.54.s:
jagrāha vegāddaiteyaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ tataḥ ..
nṛsiṃhahetorvikrāntamastravarṣamahāmbudam .. 49 ..
1.54.d:
जग्राह वेगाद्दैतेयं हिरण्यकशिपुं ततः ॥
नृसिंहहेतोर्विक्रान्तमस्त्रवर्षमहाम्बुदम् ॥ 49 ॥
1.54.m: he then violently seized the Daiteya Hiraṇyakaśipu, / who was rushing forward on account of Nṛsiṃha, a great cloud [raining] a shower of missiles.

1.54.s:
vegenotsaṃgamāropya kadalīdalalīlayā ..
dārayāmāsa daityeśaṃ vakṣatsthalamahāgirim .. 1.54.50 ..
1.54.d:
वेगेनोत्संगमारोप्य कदलीदललीलया ॥
दारयामास दैत्येशं वक्षत्स्थलमहागिरिम् ॥ 1.54.50 ॥
1.54.m: Placing him swiftly upon his lap, as easily as a plantain leaf, / he tore open the great mountain of the chest of that lord of Daityas.

1.54.s:
kṛtvā tamasubhirhīnaṃ daityeśaṃ keśavaḥ svayam ..
asurāṇāṃ vināśaṃ ca kruddho naraharirvyadhāt .. 51 ..
1.54.d:
कृत्वा तमसुभिर्हीनं दैत्येशं केशवः स्वयम् ॥
असुराणां विनाशं च क्रुद्धो नरहरिर्व्यधात् ॥ 51 ॥
1.54.m: Having deprived that lord of the Daityas of life, Keśava himself, / the enraged Narahari, brought about the destruction of the asuras.

1.54.s:
hatvā'suraṃ śoṇitabinducitraṃ saṃpūjya devāḥ saha vāsavena ..
jagmussvadhiṣṇyāni mudā sametā devopyathāntarhitamūrtirāsa .. 52 ..
1.54.d:
हत्वाऽसुरं शोणितबिन्दुचित्रं संपूज्य देवाः सह वासवेन ॥
जग्मुस्स्वधिष्ण्यानि मुदा समेता देवोप्यथान्तर्हितमूर्तिरास ॥ 52 ॥
1.54.m: Having slain the asura, the gods together with Vāsava, spotted with drops of blood, / worshipped him and went joyfully to their own abodes, and the god vanished from sight.
